title: Neon Dodge
summary: A local Canvas arcade game with keyboard/touch controls, pause, restart and a browser-local high score. No database or external assets.
features: Start, keyboard/touch movement, pause/resume and restart
Falling obstacles, collisions, score and bounded increasing difficulty
High score in localStorage, responsive neon interface and safe storage failure handling
risks: HTTP tests prove delivery, not gameplay. Complete the manual checklist.
Private browsing or disabled storage may prevent saving high scores.

tasks.title: Adapt the reviewed arcade foundation
tasks.instructions: Keep the tested arcade server and complete working Neon Dodge assets. Preserve all existing gameplay and the explicit route allowlist. Make only changes needed for this approved scope.

tasks.title: Verify delivery and document play-testing
tasks.instructions: Preserve foundation tests. Test local asset serving, health, unknown/private-path rejection and CLI startup. Keep manual gameplay checks explicit; do not fake APIs or claim source strings prove gameplay.

manual_checks.name: Start, movement and touch controls
steps: Run the downloaded app and click Start game.
Move left/right with A/D and arrow keys. On a touch device, hold Left and Right.
manual_checks.expected: The ship moves in the requested direction and stays inside the arena. Touch release stops movement.

manual_checks.name: Pause, resume and restart
steps: Start playing, press P or Pause, and wait.
Resume, then click Restart. Also switch browser tabs during play.
manual_checks.expected: Pause freezes motion and score; resume continues. Restart resets the score and obstacles. Switching away pauses the game.

manual_checks.name: Obstacles, collisions and difficulty
steps: Survive for at least 30 seconds by dodging obstacles.
Then deliberately let an obstacle hit the ship.
manual_checks.expected: Score grows while playing, difficulty increases within a cap, collision shows Game over and final score, and Play again starts a fresh run.

manual_checks.name: High score and interface
steps: Earn a score and refresh the page.
Check the saved best score. Resize the browser or open on a mobile screen.
manual_checks.expected: Best score survives refresh, the layout remains usable, and controls are readable. If storage is disabled, a notice appears and the game still runs.
